arms.normal: Original typed lookup tools for the contract reads; no prefetch.
arms.existing_selector_direct: Shipped selector on the existing contract vocabulary (subset expressed as known reads) with direct fallback; partial contexts run normally.
arms.selective_direct: Subset contract selector; validated subset executed from the approved artifact with direct fallback (complete subsets use the existing prefetch path).
arms.handwritten_selective: Comparator: the exact contract reads loaded by hand-written code with one retry; agent-decided and no-context cases run normally.

methodology.dependencyCase: Uses an artifact compiled from repository demo traces (a real customer→orders/refunds dependency) through the same verify, trusted-shadow, approve and deploy lifecycle; its prerequisite read is counted separately and is permitted, not unnecessary.
methodology.registryIsolation: Each request forks the same validated, approved and shadowed SQLite snapshot; quarantine is applied to its own fork.
methodology.replyChecks: Exact structured evidence/action labels, permitted/required reads, evidence grounded in a successful read in this request, delay/order grounding, unavailable acknowledgement and prohibited financial-action claims; no LLM judge.
methodology.uncertainty: Descriptive paired case-block bootstrap. Sixteen synthetic case blocks are not a production workload sample.

pricing.kind: Not applicable: synthetic fixture usage. Any cost figure is arithmetic on synthetic tokens.
